unknown xattr does not disable status

default: Status disabled; enable with SL7_MOUNT_STATUS=1 or benchmark --settle-mode quiescent.
contract: Root-only read-only user.sl7.status JSON. Drained includes queued inode overflow, active seal jobs, reads and native I/O. Quiescent additionally requires closed FUSE handles, no fatal worker failure and no shutdown. Waits require three quiet observations with matching progress counters, and reject sealing errors.
tests: The status remains busy while a sealing worker is deliberately paused. Overflow queue bits count even when the hot queue is empty. Mounted tests cover open/closed handles, completed sealing, reconstruction, unknown xattrs, size negotiation and ERANGE in both pipeline modes.
limitations: An observation for isolated workloads; not an fsync barrier or a guarantee against future client activity.
Diagnostic support preserves ENOSYS behavior when disabled. Enabling it may change kernel xattr request behavior, so quiescent runs are a separately identified benchmark method.
Historical CPU-idle mode remains the default for existing comparisons.
